The limit of Sibson’s \(\alpha\)-mutual information for a deterministic (high‑SNR) Gaussian channel with discrete \(X\) is known to be the Rényi entropy of order \(\beta = 2-\alpha\). This follows from the definition  

\[
I_\alpha(X;Y)=\frac{1}{\alpha-1}\log\sum_x p_X(x)\,p_Y(f(x))^{\,1-\alpha},
\]

and, when the channel becomes injective (so \(p_Y(f(x))=p_X(x)\)), it reduces to  

\[
I_\alpha(X;Y)=\frac{1}{\alpha-1}\log\sum_x p_X(x)^{\,2-\alpha}
      = H_{2-\alpha}(X).
\]

Hence the correct relationship is \(\beta = 2-\alpha\), not \(\beta = \frac{1}{1-\alpha}\).

**Verdict:** The final answer is incorrect.
